people.name: Rachel Feldman
people.role: a dentist with rooms on the third floor

secret.description: Rachel Feldman slips out to the Street from 7:30 PM to 8:00 PM to settle with a bookmaker.

people.name: Heinrich Vogel
people.role: a travelling salesman in patent medicines

secret.description: Heinrich Vogel hands a parcel of stolen goods to a man at the Kitchen at 8:00 PM.
Roscoe Tillman is not the person the register says. Nothing is hidden about the evening; the lie is in the paperwork.
Rosaria Petrosino goes through the papers in the Victim's Suite from 6:30 PM while the victim is downstairs.
Augustus Bledsoe drinks alone in the Bar from 7:30 PM to 8:00 PM and will claim to have been anywhere else.
Domenico Salerno is alone with Nora Kavanagh in the Roof Garden from 8:00 PM, and kills Nora Kavanagh at 8:00 PM.

method.name: a push from the roof garden
method.bodyEvidence: Fractures consistent with a fall of six storeys. Two fingernails torn back.

Nora Kavanagh was found in the Roof Garden. The coroner puts death between 7:30 PM and 8:00 PM. Fractures consistent with a fall of six storeys. Two fingernails torn back.
The roof door key is missing from the Front Desk. The roof door was found unlocked and the key is not on its hook.
Rain began at 8:30 PM and did not let up. Anyone out on the street after that came back in wet.
Augustus Bledsoe says Rachel Feldman came in off the street at 9:00 PM with a soaked coat, so Rachel Feldman was outside at 8:30 PM.
Roscoe Tillman says Heinrich Vogel came in off the street at 10:00 PM with a soaked coat, so Heinrich Vogel was outside at 9:30 PM.
Rachel Feldman says Augustus Bledsoe came in off the street at 11:30 PM with a soaked coat, so Augustus Bledsoe was outside at 11:00 PM.
Roscoe Tillman's papers do not hold up. The registration card gives an address in Buffalo. There is no such street in Buffalo.
Found in the Front Desk: A subpoena naming Nora Kavanagh as a witness before the grand jury, with Roscoe Tillman's name written in the margin.
Augustus Bledsoe says Nora Kavanagh said to Roscoe Tillman that a man who testifies sleeps better.
Found in the Victim's Suite: A draft codicil in Nora Kavanagh's hand striking Domenico Salerno out of the will, dated last Tuesday and unsigned.
Concetta Ruggiero says Nora Kavanagh told Domenico Salerno the lawyer was coming Thursday and that the arrangement would be changed.
